name: Assisted Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
steps: Set the counterweight on an assisted pull-up machine, grip the parallel handles with palms facing each other, and kneel carefully on the pad.
Start from straight arms with your shoulder blades engaged slightly down and core braced.
Drive your elbows smoothly downward beside your ribs to lift your chest between the handles.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension while controlling the pad all the way down.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down to limit body swinging.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears as you reach the top.
